name: Clinical
inputs: HbA1c band (T2D only); HTN diagnosis; hypoglycaemia in 12 months; DKA in 12 months

name: Comorbidity
inputs: Dyslipidaemia, BMI ≥ 30, smoking (1 each); CAD/MI, stroke/TIA, HF, PAD (3 each); retinopathy 2; neuropathy 1; foot ulcer, major amputation (4 each)

name: Kidney
inputs: eGFR band plus UACR band; CKD-stage fallback when both labs are missing (provisional)

name: Utilisation
inputs: ED visits not admitted (0–3); unplanned admissions (1 → 3, ≥ 2 → 4)
